children: has marked 137 days of silence on X, with his last post and interaction on X being on May 13.

This duration implies that Kusama has not posted on the social media platform for more than four months. It wasn't complete silence after all, as Kusama made updates to his X bio and location on different occasions.

, Kusama changed the location on his X profile to "close." Before, he changed his location on X to "backlog, Marketing and positioning." He also changed his X bio from 'Pure focus: AI App/site: ROS Finishing touches: Beta website complete. Final bug pass' to 'Polish.' as reported.
Kusama's extended absence has kept SHIB community members on their toes, especially when rumors of a possible comeback surface.
But a comeback would probably draw massive attention from the Shiba Inu community, considering how much interest has always been generated by his updates and statements.

For now, the countdown continues. With 137 days having passed since his last X post, SHIB community members are watching closely for any sign that Kusama is preparing to break his extended silence as October approaches.
Shiba Inu eyes first major golden cross in 2026
In a separate development that relates to price, Shiba Inu is about to experience its first major golden cross of 2026, with the daily chart moving averages about to converge.
The daily MA 50 is climbing steadily and is about to cross the daily MA 200, creating a golden cross, which is a bullish indication. If confirmed, this will be Shiba Inu's first golden cross of 2026.
This development remains significant for SHIB, which last saw a golden cross about two years ago.

Shiba Inu's last visible golden cross was in November 2024 and one month later, in December 2024, it reached a high of $0.0000334. Shiba Inu then went on to have a series of signals over the next few months to mark subsequent daily death cross signals.

title: Shiba Inu: Shytoshi Kusama Marks 137 Days of Silence on X, Break Coming Soon?
